entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: Can you take a shift today?[n]All my regulars just whooshed[n]in like a big drunken tornado.

entries.speaker: Lala Escargot
entries.en: And obviously you'd get a[n]little extra pay for it. I'm not[n]THAT bad a boss.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: A drunken tornado...? Sounds pretty bad.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But it does sound like it'll be worth some[n]cash. You wanna head to Shinjuku?
